about_the_game:
A young boy is entrusted with a great mission by his father to look after the spoiled princess

of the tiger tribe’s leader, Pailin!

Her own father, the chief of her tribe, has sent her to the human world to learn discipline.

But Pailin has her own goal: to prove herself by becoming the strongest in school!

And so, their funny school life begins—taking on challenges from club leaders all the way up

to the unbeatable student council president!

As a young boy tasked with looking after Pailin, the spoiled tiger-spirit princess.
Guide her growth and help her develop the skills she needs to become the strongest student!

During school life, you’ll train Pailin in various abilities, face countless challenges together,

and strengthen your bond as you overcome obstacles side by side. To support her, you’ll collect

Memories Cards—special cards earned through meaningful events you experience with her.

Combine these cards into powerful “memory combos” to give Pailin the determination

she needs to push through every trial!

After school, it’s just the two of you at home. Have a dinner, chat, and unlock new cute interactions

as your relationship deepens—one step at a time.

Diverse Interactions with Pailin

Enjoy a wide variety of activities with Pailin that expand as your relationship deepens. Talk,

have a dinner, watch TV, and discover even more heartwarming moments together!

A Lively School Life

At school, choose different actions to train Pailin’s abilities. Unexpected events await,

along with exciting encounters against powerful club leaders and the strongest

the student council president!

Collect CGs and Memories Cards Through Special Events

Experience unforgettable moments with Pailin to unlock beautiful CG artwork and earn Memories Cards.

These cards not only serve as symbols of your bond but also provide her with the determination

to overcome any challenge.

Card-Based Battles with Unpredictable Attacks

Strive toward becoming the strongest student! Build combos of determination using Memories Cards

to push Pailin past every obstacle. But beware—the battles ahead hold unexpected attacks

that only you and Pailin can face together!

Minimum:

  • Processor: 1.8GHz Dual-Core CPU or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
